claims.statement: Local claims resolve namespace-local metadata and bind volume identity/name into task mount snapshots.
limitations: CreateVolume is metadata, not distributed provisioning; claim map replacement and stale copied-node snapshot limits disclosed.

claims.statement: Agent maps resolved VolumeName to Engine name:target:mode without namespace or metadata UUID in the bind name.
limitations: Logical namespace separation does not prove equal local names use different physical volumes on one daemon.

claims.statement: Writable RWO predicate rejects any active attachment unless concurrent writers allowed; task removal detaches metadata.
limitations: Existing read-only attachment can block later writer; metadata is not physical stale-host fencing.

claims.statement: Focused scheduler fixture passed rejection of a conflicting writable RWO task.
limitations: Supplied snapshot only; no host data or storage migration.

claims.statement: MemoryService desired2/RWO fixture produced one writer and detached its attachment after injected removal.
limitations: Metadata fixture only; normal service path checked independently of pure scheduler resource bypass.

claims.statement: Stateful-service ordinals, backup hooks, replication and controlled failover remain broader design material.
limitations: Local volume MVP is not replicated storage, automatic data movement or complete backup.
